description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering license search parameters in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sort fields and default sort field.

classes.name: LicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for defining search filter parameters for licenses, allowing ordering by license name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'l.name'.
